subject: Forecast hygiene: stage clean-up and narrative asks for board packet
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Forecast hygiene: stage clean-up and narrative asks for board packet

Team —

We need a focused hygiene sweep of the booking pipeline ahead of the board packet window. Goal is to lock the ARR corridor and have a 1-page narrative + clean stage mapping by next Friday (11/20 EOD PDT). Key asks below: 

1) Stage cleanup: any deal in Commit or Commit-Review must have a 1-line rationale for why it’s there (procurement/contract cadence, PO expected date). If no rationale, move to Best Case.

2) Committed dollars: confirm dollar values and start/end dates in the Q4 workbook (attached). Any redlines to amounts — flag in the workbook and in the comments column.

3) Top-10 ARR movements: capture one-sentence reason for movement vs last week (e.g., timing shift, scope up-sell, pricing change).

4) Narrative bullets: I’m drafting the board one-pager. Please add 2–3 bullets on deal-level risk mitigations for any >$250k ARR deals NOT yet invoiced.

5) Timing: I need the stage-clean CSV and workbook updates by Thu 11/19 5pm PDT so we can fold changes into the packet and share a draft on 11/20 morning.

Attached: Q4_bookings_workbook_v3.xlsx, pipeline_stage_snapshot_20261115.csv, board_forecast_onepager_draft.docx

Thanks — please keep comments inline in the workbook; if you need to escalate any security/data questions, loop in Neha.

—
Dylan Brooks
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

- Laura: confirm FedCare legal review window by EOD (Marcus).
- Marcus: confirm any MSA/PO milestones for the Top-5 deals and add invoice timing where known.
- Vivek: please approve the corridor for the board slide (I’ll send the visual after you OK the adjustments).
